reason: A financial deep-research terminal that converts natural-language options views into evidence-linked pricing, risk, and audit decision cards, with optional live read-only data and user-confirmed simulated submissions.

summaries.zh: 面向港美股期权研究，将自然语言观点转换为包含定价、风险、证据来源和审计记录的决策卡。
summaries.en: A Hong Kong and U.S. options research terminal that turns natural-language views into decision cards with pricing, risk analysis, evidence sources, and audit records.

capabilities: Analyzes Hong Kong and U.S. options scenarios using market snapshots and deterministic pricing models
Produces research evidence summaries, risk assessments, decision cards, and audit records
Reads live quotes and account data through a Futu gateway when configured
Monitors selected macroeconomic and policy sources
Supports user-confirmed simulated order submission through Futu SIMULATE
